notes.title: Master Pyrox to become freeware, Update 1.3.2 released
notes.content:
[b]Greeting, fellow Pyromancers![/b]
Four years after the game's release, we're planning to make the game free to play for everyone. This change will happen within a week.
And as a thank you for all those who have supported us in the past and bought the game on Steam, we're releasing a brand new update today! [b]Update 1.3.2[/b] includes a couple of bugfixes, improved performance and improvements to the built-in levels. And this won't be the final version, we have at least one more update planned.

notes.title: Master Pyrox 1.3.0 released!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, fellow Pyromancers![/b]
We have a big new update for you, including new features, improvements to the multiplayer game and Steam integration, performance improvements and bugfixes. Here's a list of the most important changes:

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] UPnP support: Will take care of port mapping and make establishing a network connection much easier.
[*] Steam Invites: No one around to play? Just invite Steam friends to your lobby.
[*] Added a new chat window to the lobby.
[*] Vibration feedback for gamepads that support it.
[*] A dedicated "Trophies" window for the achievements.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Achievements are stored locally when playing without a Steam connection.
[*] Updated the design of some arenas, including colours and lights.
[*] Optimised textures, materials and effects for better performance.
[*] Fixed occasional stuttering when new objects appear on the screen.
[*] Updated to Godot Engine 3.1.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Attacking a wizard who is casting a spell.
[*] Master Pyrox using teleporters.
[*] Master Pyrox using the shield power up.
[*] Fixed a few glitches and clipping errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Steam lobby support and improved network gaming with Master Pyrox 1.2.1
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow pyromancers!

Update 1.2.1 focuses on improving the network multiplayer experience. When hosting a new game, you can now choose to create a Steam lobby. Other Steam players will be able to see the lobby and join your game. We also made setting up a local network game easier and fixed a couple of bugs.

Here's a detailed list of what's new:
[list]
[*]Added Steam lobby support. When hosting a game, players can choose to create a Steam lobby, so other players can see and join the game.
[*]The network GUI displays all available Steam lobbies and local games that can be joined.
[*]Hosts can remove other players from their game.
[*]Fixed and improved detection of local network games.
[*]Updated German translation.
[/list]

Note: Setting up a [i]local[/i] network game is now as easy as it can get. No manual configuration is needed. The same goes for [i]joining[/i] an online game. However, if you're [i]hosting[/i] an online game, you still have to make sure that the network port used for the game is open. In one of the next updates we're going to add UPnP support, which will take care of this and make it even easier to set up an online game.

We hope you'll enjoy these new features. And we're not done yet! More updates will follow with performance improvements and additional features for the network game. We're also planning to port Master Pyrox to mobile devices. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Master Pyrox 1.2.0 released!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow pyromancers!

We have a new update for you. Version 1.2.0 brings a couple of new features and improvements:

[list]
[*]New spell: "Attractor" - a magic gravity well that attracts fireballs and floating players.
[*]The network GUI can find any servers in the local network, making it easier to set up a local network game.
[*]Removed fade-in and fade-out in practice mode, the player now respawns immediately.
[*]Background animations can be switched off for better preformance on older computers.
[*]The Godot engine has been updated to the latest version.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy our little game! If you have any questions, suggestions, bug reports or feature requests, feel free to post them in our community board. And if you like the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam.

notes.title: Master Pyrox 1.1.0 released!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow pyromancers!

We have just released a new content update for Master Pyrox. The update includes the following changes:
 [list]
    [*]New boss: [b]Gerhardt the Troll[/b] likes to punch Wizards and destroy things.
    [*]New spell: Water Shot
    [*]Updated some of the arenas, including a new garden.
    [*]A few new textures and objects for the level editor
    [*]Improved the AI of some bosses.
    [*]Fixed a few rare crashes and bugs.
[/list]
We hope that you'll enjoy this update! We are planning to release more updates over the next months, further improving the game and adding more fun content. If you have any suggestions or features you'd like to see in the game, feel free to post them on our discussion board. And if you like the game, please leave a review on Steam and help us spread the word!

notes.title: Master Pyrox Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow pyromancers!

Today we're releasing our first little update for the game. It comes with the following new features and changes:
 [list]
    [*]Added a zoomed-in camera mode that follows the player in singleplayer and network games
    [*]Added a new achievement
    [*]Fixed a few minor graphical glitches
    [*]Optimised some light and material settings.
    [*]Updated the German translation
[/list]
We have plans for bigger content updates in the future: updated maps, new bosses, new objects... so stay tuned, and if you have any ideas for features you'd like to see in the game, let us know!

Denis
